newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle market roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle market roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade rather slow. Slaughter steers and heifers steady. Inquiry and demand moderate. Feedlots very current.

Sales confirmed on 5,700 slaughter steers and 1,000 slaughter heifers Thursday. For the week to date 10,4900 head confirmed including 12,500 head or about 12 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1200 lbs 68.00; few Select with end Choice 1175-1225 lbs 67.00-67.50;
few Select and Choice 1250-1275 lb Holsteins 60.00-61.00.
Dressed basis - Pen Select to mostly Choice 1175 lbs 108.00;
Pen Select and Choice 2-3 1250 lb Holsteins, Choice 105.00, Select 98.00, hot weights delivered.

Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1025-1050 lbs 67.00 to mostly 68.00, pen Select with end Choice 1075 lbs 67.00. Dressed basis - Pen Select to mostly Choice 1150 lbs 108.00 hot weights, delivered.
Wk to date - 104,900 last week - 79,800 last year - 88,600
